segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Thorndyke’s

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Good morning. Is that Mr Thorndyke?

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Speaking. How can I help?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: I’ve got quite a few things which need painting and fixing in the flat and I wonder whether you’d be able to do the work.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: I’m sure I’d be able to help but let me take down a few details.

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Yes, of course.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Well, firstly, how did you hear about us?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: It was my friend May Hampton ... you did some excellent work for her a couple of years ago. Do you remember?

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Oh, yes, that was in West Park Flats, lovely lady.

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Yes, she is.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: And what’s your name, please?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: It’s Edith Pargetter. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Edith ... can you spell your surname, please?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: It’s P-A-R-G-E-double T-E-R.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Double T, right. And do you live in West Park Flats as well?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: No, actually it’s East [[ ]] Park, Flat 4.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Oh, right, that’s over the road, I seem to remember – quite difficult to get to.

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Yes, it’s at the back of the library. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Right, I know. And what’s your phone number?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: 875934 but I’m out a great deal in the afternoons and evenings.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: So would the best time to ring you be in the morning? [[ ]]

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Yes.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Fine. I’ve made a note of that. Can I just ask, I’ll be in a van and I know parking’s rather difficult round your flats. Where would you recommend?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Well, I always tell people in larger vehicles to park by the postbox on the other side of the road from the entrance. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Good, thanks.

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: And will you be able to give me a full itemised quote?

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Oh, yes, I’ll list all the jobs separately with individual prices. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: That’d be a great help.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: No problem. ——————————-

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Now, what would you like me to do?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Firstly and most urgently is in the kitchen. With all the weather damage, the glass in the door has cracked and I’d need that fixing ...

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: I presume you mean replacing? [[ ]]

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Oh, yes. And as soon as possible ...

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: What I’ll do is come round tomorrow morning and do that immediately.

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Thank you so much. The other things aren’t so urgent but ...

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Now, I’ll make a note of everything you want doing.

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Well, in the kitchen I’d like some painting doing.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: All the kitchen walls?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Just the area over the cooker [[ ]] . It’s very greasy ...

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Right ... it does tend to get that way!

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Yes!

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Well, if you want a proper job done what I’d need to do is strip the old paint and plaster it about a week before I paint it. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Of course. Now, May tells me you also do work in the garden.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: That’s right.

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Well, I’d like you to replace a fence. [[ ]]

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Just one?

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: Yes, at the far end.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Fine. Shouldn’t be a problem.

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: And that’s the lot.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: Fine. Yeah, as I say I can come round tomorrow morning to look over things with you.

segments.speaker: EDITH
segments.en: That’s great, thank you.

segments.speaker: MR THORNDYKE
segments.en: So, I’ll look forward to seeing you tomorrow at ...
